QuestInfo.name: [Eluna] The Unending Journey
QuestInfo.0: After you provided her with new evidence, #p9400464# deduced that her ancestors left planet Eluna after they exhausted their supply of potable water.\r\nAsk #p9400464# what this means for the Ryuul's plans.
QuestInfo.1: #p9400464# says they will leave again to find the answer to their fundamental question.\r\nShe urges you to never stop asking questions, saying that questions are the path to all progress.
